notes: DJI D-Log M drone clip, Nov 10 2026: snowy creek and evergreens rising to a sunlit golden peak under a pale blue sky. Log footage needs real contrast and color: the golden alpenglow is the featured hue, evergreens a little richer, sky a little bluer, snow kept white (no warm highlight tint). No people, so the skin guard is off so the golden light can glow. Nov 12 revision: the user saw the trees go black as the gold peak comes into view, so the curve's dark end is lifted (shadows about 3x brighter, true black kept) while the bright end is unchanged; gold +38% (was +35%) so the peak measures the same as before. Nov 12 revision 3 (replaces revision 2, whose shadow and highlight moves changed over time and squeezed the midtones, so all the browns shifted at 12 s): exposure_offsets undo only the camera's real exposure dip (about 0.1 in code value, 13-17 s, measured frame to frame), the same for every color; shadow_lift_keys lift only the darkest tones so the backlit trees stay at about the early forest's brightness, easing up to a little brighter as the peak comes in (Y 66 to 76); a fixed warm_highlights rule brings the washed-out sunlit peak (12.5-15 s) to the same gold as later. Gold gain 1.3 so the gold matches the approved version. The curve's shadow lift stays halved. Revision 3b: the washed-out peak (12.5-14 s) came out yellower (hue 83-87) than the settled gold (62-64); warm_highlights hue -150 turns clearly washed-out warm highlights toward orange, so the gold stays at hue 58-63 from start to finish. Revision 4: the user found the mountain 'wayyy too orange' with no visible tree detail. The warm-highlight rule had been easing every bright warm pixel, which flattened the texture (detail 30 vs 45 in the approved version) and the hue turn made it redder (58 vs 63). Now the rule runs only while the peak is washed out (strength_keys, 12.5-15.5 s) and gently (ceiling 0.80, color 3, hue -80); the even exposure offsets are gone because they brightened the peak too; gold gain back to the approved 1.38. From 16 s the mountain measures the same as the approved version; shadow_lift_keys re-solved so the trees still go 66 -> 76.
